The 30 drawings cover **7 subsystems**:

| Subsystem | Drawings | Count |
|---|---|---:|
| Box / enclosure | D-001–D-005 | 5 |
| Powder | D-006–D-010 | 5 |
| Recoater | D-011–D-015 | 5 |
| Optics | D-016–D-020 | 5 |
| Gas flow | D-021–D-022 | 2 |
| Build plate | D-023–D-028 | 6 |
| Z-axis | D-029–D-030 | 2 |
| **Total** |  | **30** |

D-006, “Canister Wall,” is counted under Powder.

The BOM does not label a single “Z-axis” family. The Z-axis parts are mainly in **Build-plate** and **SensorGantry**; the Build-plate parts form the build-platform lift assembly.

| BOM row | Drawing in the supplied set |
|---|---|
| Build cylinder | **D-023 — BuildCylinder_v2** |
| Build base | **D-024 — ByggeBase** |
| Seal clamp plate | **D-025 — ByggeBaseRing** (likely match by function) |
| Build Plate | **D-026 — ByggePlade** |
| Build cylinder clamp ring | **D-027 — CylinderSpændRing** |
| Heating element plate | **D-028 — VarmeElementPlade** |
| Motor plate | **D-030 — Z-axis_MotorPlate** |
| Motor plate shaft | No matching drawing shown |
| NEMA 23 Tr11x2 Non-Captive | No matching fabrication drawing shown |
| Stepper driver NEMA23 | No matching fabrication drawing shown |
| Heating element | No matching fabrication drawing shown |
| Thermocouple plate | No matching drawing shown |
| Ceramic build base seal | No matching drawing shown |

The other explicitly Z-named BOM rows are in **SensorGantry**: **Z axis linear rod**, **Z axis stepper bracket**, **Z axis linear stepper**, **Z axis guide clamp**, and **Z axis linear guide**. No exact matching row drawing is apparent for these in the supplied set. **D-029 — Z-axis_BottomPlate** is a Z-axis drawing, but the BOM has no row named “Z-axis bottom plate.”

The supplied recoater drawings show five fabricated parts:

- **Recoater arm** — D-011  
- **Recoater mount block** — D-012  
- **Recoater adjustment plate** — D-013  
- **Recoater stage plate** — D-014  
- **Silicone wiper/blade** — D-015, two pieces  

The wiper is fitted to the recoater assembly; the drawings also specify the mounting plates, block, and arm that support and position it.
The recoater stage plate is documented in **Drawing D-014, “Recoater Linear Plate.”**
D-010 documents the **Powder stepper bracket** BOM row. The drawing specifies a 2 mm non-magnetic stainless-steel motor plate, matching that powder-system part.
The BOM’s **Motor plate** corresponds to drawing **D-030, “Z-axis MotorPlate.”** Drawing **D-029** is titled “Z-axis BottomPlate.”

They agree that the doors are **3 mm aluminium** and that the drawing applies to **two doors**. The drawing specifies through-holes, not threaded holes, which is consistent with the BOM note that the delivered holes were unthreaded and the drawings were correct.

There is a possible mismatch in the door details: drawing D-001 shows one design “Door – x2,” while the BOM describes a front door with a viewing window and a back door without one. The drawing text does not clearly show or distinguish those window arrangements.
The Left Side Box interfaces with the Print Platform, Top Side, Front Side Box, and Back Box.
The **Left Side Box, Front Side Box, Back Box, and Right Box** connect to the print platform. The platform also bridges the **Z-axis, recoater, and powder-handling subsystems**.
The cylinder clamp ring attaches to the build platform, clamping the build cylinder in place.
The 1 mm silicone wiper is held by an aluminium recoater clamp, which secures it to the recoater head. The wiper drawing shows eight Ø3.4 mm through-holes for fastening.
No. The BOM lists the recoater arm as aluminium, and its drawing specifies 7075 aluminium alloy.

The drawing specifies **AISI 316 stainless-steel sheet**. The BOM lists the build plate material as **“Stainless steel, Steel,”** so it broadly agrees, but it does not mention the drawing’s note that plates may be made in **aluminium** as well (“stainless and aluminium,” 1–3 of each).

The silicone parts are:

- **Recoater Blade** — 1 mm silicone sheet; the drawing specifies two silicone wipers.
- **Silicone gasket f-theta ring** — 1 mm silicone rubber gasket.

The BOM also lists **silicone sheet** as raw material for making gaskets.
The laser source was supplied by **Max Photonics** and cost **DKK 45,000**.

The Box subsystem has **DKK 5,627** in recorded BOM costs, summing the “Total cost” entries for parts in the Box family.

That is a **recorded-cost subtotal, not the full build cost**: most custom-fabricated enclosure parts—including the walls, platform, bracing, and window frame—are listed at DKK 0. Their material, fabrication, and labor costs are therefore not included. Any other unpriced items or incidental costs are also outside the figure.
The order number was **180-9104**.
No. The BOM lists the DM332T at **DKK 96.00** for the recoater and **DKK 99.42** for the build plate.
The oxygen sensor is listed at **DKK 5,500.00**.
D-030 does not specify a weight.
The recoater arm weighs **415.3 g** (as indicated on drawing D-011).
Sheet 2 is at a scale of **1:5**.
The build cylinder’s inside surface should be smooth, with a roughness of **Ra 0.4–0.8 µm**.
The documents do not specify a tensile strength for the build plate. The drawing identifies it as AISI 316 stainless-steel sheet.

The **recoater mount block** is drawing **D-012 (RecoaterMountBlock.PDF)**. It’s an aluminium threaded block connecting the recoater stage plate to the arm.

**Drawing details:** EN-AW 5005 aluminium; 120 mm long, 40 mm wide, and about 25 mm thick. It has two sets of **2 × Ø5 mm through-holes tapped M6**, with 30 mm spacing shown. Other drawing dimensions include 15 ±1 mm, 12.5 ±0.1 mm, and 117.3 mm.

I can’t display the original drawing image here, but those are its identifying features and dimensions.
The heating element plate is **2–3 mm thick** (drawing D-028).

Here’s a **schematic 3D view** of the Build Base Ring (drawing D-025):

         \      o \________________________/ o      /
          `.                                         .'
            `-.   o                         o   .-'

It is a **flat annular plate**, shown with its thickness exaggerated: **Ø250 mm outer diameter**, **Ø224 mm inner diameter**, and **8 through-holes Ø3.4 mm** with **Ø6.9 mm × 90° countersinks**. The drawing gives an **aluminium** ring thickness of **2–3 mm**. This is illustrative, not a scale-accurate model.

Corrected: the BOM entry for **Build Plate** should list **Aluminium**, not stainless steel.

**Drawing D-026 currently conflicts with that:** its material callout says “AISI 316 Stainless Steel Sheet,” while the note says to make both stainless-steel and aluminium versions. The drawing should be updated to specify aluminium for the build plate; the aluminium alloy grade isn’t identified in the provided documents.
